headline: Argentina Tax Agency ARCA Extends Income Tax Filing Deadlines
summary: Argentina's tax authority ARCA postponed the deadline for individual income tax affidavits for the 2025 fiscal period to November 16, while extending special payment regime enrollments to December 30.
why: Tax filing extensions provide temporary administrative relief for individual taxpayers and corporate compliance departments navigating regulatory updates.

impacts.name: Argentina
impacts.why: Extended deadlines defer tax cash outflows for individuals and businesses.
